card.name: Word-start pieces inside split drug terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split in two, such as the L in Stimulant Laxatives, the sol in MMF solubility, or L in LILETTA. It is seen in drug-interaction and dosing sections.

modes.label: L before axatives
modes.description: The letter L that begins the word laxatives after the heading Stimulant.
modes.example: 7.3 Stimulant<< L>>axatives Concurrent use of stimulant lax

modes.label: sol in solubility or solifenacin
modes.description: The piece sol that begins a word such as solubility or solifenacin.
modes.example: possibly due to a decrease in MMF<< sol>>ubility at an increased gastric pH.

modes.label: L in a brand name
modes.description: The L that opens the brand name LILETTA.
